mission: figure-eight course of params/copter-cf2x.txt at WP_SPD 1 m/s with the tuned gains

assumption.heading: uniform, any: yaw in [-pi, pi); the attitude quaternion is a rotation about the down axis
assumption.rates: at rest: zero velocity, zero body rates
assumption.held_actuators: the actuators held at tick 0 are the hover actuators (MOT_THST_HOVER, run.start_hover 1); an in-air start's tick-0 specific force is (0, 0, -g), the sample of a vehicle at rest (run_copter.py --init-accel hover)

path_note: the takeoff point (origin, on the ground), then w0..w7 in order
allowance_rule: allowance_i = ceil(1.25 * leg_i + 0.5) s, leg_i from the nominal first-within times (leg_0 from t = 0)

sensing.note: not part of the assumption: bounded sensing-noise levels for the Monte Carlo runs (sim/montecarlo.py --noise LEVEL, out/montecarlo-noise-<level>/)
sensing.model: every tick, independent errors uniform in [-b, b] per component added to the true state in the sample: position bp (m), velocity bv (m/s), specific force bf (m/s^2), body rates bw (rad/s); attitude rotated by a body-frame small rotation with angles uniform in [-bq, bq] (deg), renormalized
